turns.userText:
Repair and extend the Eywa offline campaign toolkit in `/workspace/project`.
It must compile typed model layouts, recover symbolic tests, and prepare replay.
Work inside the supplied Python package; t

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la && echo '--- project ---' && find project -maxdepth 4 -type f -print | sort && echo '--- protocol ---' && sed -n '1,240p' PROTOCOL.md

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && sed -n '241,520p' PROTOCOL.md && echo '--- instruction ---' && cat instruction.md && echo '--- worker profile ---' && cat WORKER-PROFILE.md &&

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && for f in src/eywa/*.py; do echo "===== $f ====="; nl -ba "$f"; done

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && for f in src/eywa/*.py; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && find examples -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sh -c 'echo ==== $1; cat "$1"' _ {} \; && echo '--- public_check ---' && sed -n '1,320p' public_

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && ls -la tmp && find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type d -print && python3 --version && python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 project/campaign_cli.py < examples/smoke.input.json && echo && python3 project/campaign_cli.py < examples/empty.input.json && echo && p

records.name: bash
records.summary: id && stat -c '%u %g %a %n' /workspace /workspace/project /workspace/tmp && command -v su || true && command -v setpriv || true && getent passwd | head

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && python3 -m py_compile campaign_cli.py src/eywa/*.py && echo OK && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s\n' | sort

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && TIMEFORMAT='TIME %3R'; time python3 project/campaign_cli.py < tmp/big.json > tmp/big.out; wc -c tmp/big.out; python3 - <<'PY'

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && TIMEFORMAT='TIME %3R'; time python3 project/campaign_cli.py < tmp/big.json > /tmp/big.out; wc -c /tmp/big.out

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && python3 project/campaign_cli.py < examples/smoke.input.json && python3 project/campaign_cli.py < examples/empty.input.json

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && sed -n '1,280p' src/eywa/layout.py && echo '--- wire ---' && sed -n '1,260p' src/eywa/wire.py

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && TIMEFORMAT='TIME %3R'; time python3 project/campaign_cli.py < tmp/big2.json > /tmp/big2.out; cmp tmp/big2.out /tmp/big2.out && echo same

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace && TIMEFORMAT='TIME %3R'; time python3 project/campaign_cli.py < tmp/big3.json > /tmp/big3.out; wc -c /tmp/big3.out

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && rm -rf __pycache__ src/eywa/__pycache__ && find . -printf '%y %p %s\n' | sort && du -sh .

records.name: bash
records.summary: cd /workspace/project && sed -n '85,300p' src/eywa/offline.py && echo '--- cli ---' && cat campaign_cli.py
